summary: Creative coloring game where kids explore, imagine and combine colors
description:
ADD COLOR TO A PAPER WORLD!
Color in an object… and the next one appears instantly! A tree, a horse, a tractor, a balloon… The paper folds and unfolds, slowly revealing an entire world made of paper and origami.

Mix your colors and discover new shades! Red, yellow, blue… then green, purple, or brown when you combine them. If you're happy with your creation, take a picture! And that’s not all: once the coloring is done, have fun tossing little paper balls. Surprise guaranteed!

Pango Colors helps children explore color mixing while developing patience, focus, and creativity from age 3.

A PANGO CREATION
For more than 15 years, Pango games have helped children grow gently. Over 15 million children around the world use them.
Pango Colors continues this mission by offering a calming, creative experience centered around coloring and paper.

WHY PARENTS LOVE PANGO COLORS
- Teaches intuitive color mixing
- Develops fine motor skills and concentration
- Encourages creativity and self-expression
- Over 60 objects to color and transform
- 4 paper worlds to enrich and explore
- No stress, no competition, at their own pace

A 100% SAFE GAME FOR CHILDREN
• No in-app purchases
• No ads
• No external links
• Built-in parental control
• Complies with children's data protection standards

PANGO VALUES: CREATIVITY, DISCOVERY, CALM
At Pango, we design games that encourage imagination, patience, and gentle exploration. Our worlds provide a soothing space where every child can create at their own rhythm.
